g.text: Saved C16 cruise model · one native F3 unit · no model change
A–B: complex response at 1.1573777 Hz. Colored arrows add tip-to-tail; the dark vector is the full saved response.
C–D: body-relative displacement and infinitesimal rotation components of the 1.233 Hz pair.
